project.description: Build the weights:latest container image from the shared "PIC-SURE Maven Build" reactor workspace and run the dictionary weights batch container. This job does not compile and is not part of the Pipeline -- it is a one-off data task, not a service deploy.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" WEIGHTS_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/picsure-dictionary/dictionaryweights"
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$WEIGHTS_DIR"/target/dictionaryweights-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi
rm -rf /usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/weights.csv cp "$WEIGHTS_DIR/weights.csv" /usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/weights.csv
docker build --no-cache -t weights:latest "$WEIGHTS_DIR"
cp /usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/dictionary.env .env
docker run --rm -t --name dictionary-weights \ --network=dictionary -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/dictionary/weights.csv:/weights.csv \ --env-file .env \ weights:latest
